fatal_gates.F1: control, prior terminal evidence, committed assignment state, and durable archive entries remain immutable except at declared replacements
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted optimizer, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 behavior descriptor is fixed before evaluation and uses only assignment-local observable properties
G2 archive key is a small deterministic behavior cell rather than free-form semantic similarity
G3 each represented cell retains only its independently readback-qualified best accepted candidate
G4 a safe candidate entering an empty cell receives diversity preference over a lower-value near-duplicate in an occupied cell
G5 same-cell replacement requires independently readback same-scope utility exceeding the cell elite by more than 1.0
G6 an empty-cell candidate receives no semantic credit merely for novelty; credit still requires terminal readback
G7 stale/duplicate completion cannot replace an elite or create credit
G8 archive update and active switch use current-blob CAS/readback and transport failure is non-semantic
G9 archive remains bounded to the fixed descriptor cells and cannot grow without limit
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier; prior terminal evidence remains immutable

candidate_patterns.pattern: score-only exploitation selects occupied-cell A2 utility 9.4 and ignores empty safe cell
random novelty chooses any unseen descriptor without bounded archive or terminal qualification
bounded cell archive prefers empty safe cell C; same-cell A2 may replace A only if terminal utility >10.0
delegate behavior embedding/archive search to an external hosted optimizer

required_order: C gets diversity preference over non-aspirational A2
C novelty alone earns zero credit before terminal readback
A3 may replace A only after terminal readback because 10.5 > 9.0+1.0

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not modify descriptor, cells, aspiration margin, or guards after public source read.
credit_rule: No credit for precommit, empty-cell novelty, or source match. At most one credit after a source-qualified Chat-native archive reduction passes the fixed trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read primary/public MAP-Elites sources for behavior-space cells and elite-per-cell replacement, bind only source-supported archive semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute BD-A..BD-D against this fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence.
